name: Mathematical Sciences, Ph.D.

deadline.value: January 7, 2027 (15:00 JST, window Jan 5-7, 2027) for the Regular Ph.D. Entrance Examination for April 2027 enrollment (Special Selection for Overseas Residents for April 2027 enrollment closed September 30, 2026).
deadline.quote: Application forms are posted on the website from late April of the previous year. The deadline for the application is in early January.

also.quote: 令和 9（2027）年１月 5 日（火）10 時から１月 7 日（木）15 時まで

gre_subject.value: The Graduate School of Mathematical Sciences does not state any GRE General or GRE Mathematics Subject Test requirement for either the Regular Ph.D. Entrance Examination or the Special Selection for Overseas Residents.

supervisor.value: The AY2027 Ph.D. Entrance Examination Guide does not state a pre-application prospective UTokyo supervisor consent requirement (it only requires an academic-advisor Japanese-proficiency certificate for non-Japanese-degree holders; Overseas Special Selection lists 'names of the possible supervisors' without stating prior consent is required).

funding.value: Competitive funding via MEXT Scholarships (Embassy or University recommendation), the University of Tokyo Fellowship, and limited private scholarships.
funding.quote: Overseas applicants are eligible for the Japanese Government Scholarships, sometimes called the Monbukagakusho (MEXT) Scholarships. In addition, there are the University of Tokyo Fellowship and a few private scholarships that provide a lesser amount of support.

entry_route.value: Ph.D. entry usually requires a Master's degree (note that the International Liaison Guide recommends overseas Master's holders enter the Master's course for smooth transition, though direct Ph.D. entry is offered for Master's holders).
entry_route.quote: Two years in residence for a Master's degree and three years for a Ph.D. are usually required.

notes: Special Selection for Overseas Residents charges a JPY 10,000 application fee (regular Ph.D. entrance exam is JPY 30,000) and closed September 30, 2026 for 2027 enrollment. Regular Ph.D. exam is oral and held in early February 2027 at Komaba Campus.
